prompts.name: dl_half_up1
prompts.prompt: Image restoration task only: upscale and enhance this exact photo. Remove blur, video compression artifacts and noise, sharpen fine detail and edges. Keep EVERYTHING identical: same composition, same framing, same two people in the same positions, same faces and facial features, same expressions, same bald head of the man on the right, same hair of the man on the left, same suit, tie, microphone, yellow badge, same background, colors and lighting, same left-right split. Do not add, remove, move or redraw anything. Do not change any face. No text, no letters.

prompts.name: dl_half_up2
prompts.prompt: Restore this photo to high definition like a sharp DSLR still. Pixel-faithful restoration only: denoise, deblock, sharpen skin texture, hair, fabric and edges. The identity, face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, expression and head of each person must stay exactly the same. The man on the right is completely bald and must stay bald. Keep the composition, crop, colors and the left-right half split exactly. Add nothing. No text.
